name: Cairo & Luxor Pharaonic Journey — 6 Days
description: Trace the footsteps of the pharaohs on this unforgettable journey along the Nile. Begin in Cairo with the Great Pyramids and the Egyptian Museum, then fly south to Luxor — the world's greatest open-air museum — for Karnak Temple, the Valley of the Kings, and a sunset felucca ride on the Nile.
inclusions: Cairo: Pyramids of Giza & Sphinx guided tour
Luxor: Karnak Temple & Valley of the Kings guided tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cairo International Airport and transfer to your hotel in Giza. After settling in, enjoy a welcome dinner with views of the illuminated pyramids.
activities: Welcome dinner at a Nile-view restaurant

itinerary.title: Giza Plateau & Egyptian Museum
itinerary.description: A full day exploring ancient Cairo's greatest treasures. Morning at the Giza Plateau to see the three great pyramids and the Sphinx up close; afternoon at the Egyptian Museum to marvel at Tutankhamun's golden death mask.
activities: Giza Plateau & Great Sphinx guided tour

itinerary.title: Islamic Cairo & Coptic Quarter
itinerary.description: Explore the medieval layers of Cairo — from the Ottoman mansions of Al-Muizz Street to the ancient churches of Coptic Cairo.
activities: Citadel of Saladin & Mohammed Ali Mosque

itinerary.title: Fly to Luxor — East Bank
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Luxor, the ancient city of Thebes. After hotel check-in, spend the afternoon exploring the magnificent temples of the East Bank.

itinerary.title: Valley of the Kings & West Bank
itinerary.description: Cross to the West Bank for the most iconic archaeological sites in the world — the Valley of the Kings, the Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut, and the Colossi of Memnon.
activities: Valley of the Kings (3 tombs included)
Temple of Hatshepsut at Deir el-Bahari

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning before your transfer to Luxor Airport for your onward journey.

name: Dubai Modern Escape — 5 Days
description: Experience the spectacular contrast of old and new in the UAE's most dazzling city. Ascend the world's tallest building, cruise the historic creek by wooden abra, discover Emirati heritage in the Al Fahidi neighbourhood, and lose yourself in the gold and spice souks — all in five extraordinary days.
inclusions: 5 nights in a 5-star Downtown Dubai hotel
Burj Khalifa At the Top (124th floor) tickets
Desert safari with dune bashing & BBQ dinner
Dubai Creek abra boat ride & souks tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai
itinerary.description: Touch down in Dubai and transfer to your luxury hotel near Downtown. Spend the afternoon at leisure, then enjoy an evening stroll along the Dubai Fountain at the base of the Burj Khalifa.
activities: Dubai Fountain & Dubai Mall evening walk

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa & Downtown Icons
itinerary.description: A full day in the heart of modern Dubai. Morning ascent of the Burj Khalifa for panoramic city views, then explore the Dubai Mall — one of the world's largest shopping centres — and the nearby Dubai Aquarium.
activities: Burj Khalifa At the Top (124th floor) guided visit

itinerary.title: Old Dubai — Creek, Gold & Spice Souks
itinerary.description: Step back in time on the historic Dubai Creek. Cross by traditional abra wooden boat to the Deira side and immerse yourself in the sensory world of the Gold and Spice Souks.
activities: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood walking tour
Abra boat ride across Dubai Creek
Traditional Emirati lunch at Al Fanar

itinerary.title: Desert Safari Adventure
itinerary.description: Leave the city behind for the golden dunes of the Dubai desert. An afternoon of dune bashing, sandboarding, and camel riding leads into a magical evening at a Bedouin camp.
activities: Hotel pickup for afternoon desert safari
Bedouin camp: henna, falconry, live entertainment
Traditional BBQ dinner under the stars

itinerary.title: Leisure & Departure
itinerary.description: A final morning to shop, relax by the pool, or visit a neighbourhood you missed. Transfer to the airport for your onward flight.
activities: Optional: Alserkal Avenue contemporary art visit

name: Istanbul Bosphorus & History — 7 Days
description: The only city in the world that straddles two continents, Istanbul rewards every traveller with layers of Byzantine, Ottoman, and modern culture. Seven days to explore Hagia Sophia, the Grand Bazaar, the Bosphorus strait, and the colourful back streets of Balat — an itinerary that barely scratches the surface.
inclusions: 7 nights in a 4-star hotel in Sultanahmet or Beyoglu
Hagia Sophia & Blue Mosque guided tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.description: Land at Istanbul Airport and transfer to your hotel in the historic Sultanahmet district. Freshen up and take a short walk to see the Blue Mosque illuminated at night.
activities: Welcome dinner at a rooftop restaurant

itinerary.title: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque & Topkapi Palace
itinerary.description: The heart of Byzantine and Ottoman Istanbul in a single day. Morning at Hagia Sophia with a guided tour of its glittering mosaics; afternoon at Topkapi Palace's treasury and harem.
activities: Blue Mosque visit (open for non-worshippers outside prayer times)

itinerary.title: Grand Bazaar & Spice Market
itinerary.description: Devote a full morning to getting delightfully lost in the 4,000-shop labyrinth of the Grand Bazaar, then follow your nose to the vivid Spice Market on the Golden Horn waterfront.
activities: Galata Bridge walk & fresh fish lunch

itinerary.title: Full-Day Bosphorus Cruise
itinerary.description: Spend the day on the water, gliding between Europe and Asia along the strait that has shaped civilisations. The cruise passes Ottoman palaces, fortresses, and charming fishing villages.

itinerary.title: Balat, Fener & the Golden Horn
itinerary.description: Discover Istanbul's hidden, colourful side in the historic Greek and Jewish neighbourhoods of Balat and Fener, where peeling pastel townhouses and neighbourhood coffee shops line cobblestone streets.

itinerary.title: Asian Istanbul — Kadıköy & Üsküdar
itinerary.description: Cross to the Asian side by ferry for a completely different Istanbul experience: the lively Kadıköy market, the Moda waterfront promenade, and the hilltop Çamlıca Mosque.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Departure
itinerary.description: A final morning for last-minute shopping, a Turkish bath (hammam), or simply lingering over çay in a Grand Bazaar tea house. Then transfer to the airport.
activities: Final Grand Bazaar or Istiklal Avenue shopping
